styles.name: ds-calendar
styles.styleLess: display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--spacing-2, 8px); padding: var(--spacing-3, 12px); font-family: var(--font-family-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: var(--font-size-sm);

styles.name: ds-calendar__nav
styles.styleLess: display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;

styles.name: ds-calendar__title
styles.styleLess: font-size: var(--font-size-sm); font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold); color: var(--foreground);

styles.name: ds-calendar__head
styles.styleLess: font-size: var(--font-size-xs); font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium); color: var(--muted-foreground); text-align: center; padding-bottom: var(--spacing-2, 8px); width: 36px;

styles.name: ds-calendar__day
styles.styleLess: width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: none; color: var(--foreground); font-family: inherit; font-size: var(--font-size-sm); font-weight: var(--font-weight-regular); line-height: 1; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; transition: background-color var(--duration-100) var(--easing-in-out);

styles.name: ds-calendar__day--today
styles.styleLess: font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary);
